beats.anchor: Le Real Club Atlético Castellana entre au pas.
beats.extras: The Castellana team from Madrid: eleven tall, athletic white boys of 13 and 14, all with the same short neat haircut, in matching white tracksuits with a violet band, marching onto the pitch in step, in one straight line, silent, chins up. At the front, their number 6: a blond boy with very pale eyes and a calm, cold face. Beside the brothers, their teammates in sand gold: Pol Vidal, a tall broad white boy of 13 whispering; Nil Soler, a tall, very thin white boy with sticking out ears; Laia Ferrer, 13, white, freckles, brown bun.
beats.outfit: BriBri (14) in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band and number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. Kaydoudou (12) in the same sand gold kit, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, his soft little afro.
beats.action: In the foreground, the Costa Daurada players stand in a loose group at the edge of the pitch and watch the white line march past. BriBri watches calmly, studying them. Kaydoudou leans toward his brother with a hand cupped at his mouth, whispering a joke, eyes wide. Pol mouths a word to Nil.
beats.location: A small harbour stadium in Catalonia: a covered stand on one side, concrete terraces on the other, and behind one goal the masts of sailing boats rocking above the harbour wall, the sea beyond.
beats.light: Early evening in May, the sun low and golden, the floodlights just switched on, long shadows stretching across the pitch.
beats.camera: Wide shot from behind the Costa Daurada group, the brothers' backs and profiles in the foreground, the white line of marching players crossing the middle of the frame.
beats.alt: Les invincibles de Madrid entrent au pas, en survêtements blancs, pendant que Kaydoudou chuchote une blague à son frère.

beats.extras: Two Castellana defenders of 13 and 14, tall white boys in white kits with violet trim, squeezed together on Kaydoudou, legs stretched, beaten. Behind them, the Castellana number 6, a blond boy with very pale eyes, shouting with one arm raised, too late. Their goalkeeper, a tall white boy in a violet kit, starting to come off his line.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot, the gap in his front teeth visible as he grits them. BriBri (14) in the same kit with number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: Kaydoudou, near the left edge of the penalty area, has just slipped the ball low along the grass between the two defenders who closed in on him. The ball rolls into the path of BriBri, who is running into the empty space inside the box, eyes locked on the ball, mouth set. Kaydoudou's head is up, watching his brother, one arm out for balance.
beats.location: The penalty area of a small harbour stadium in Catalonia at dusk, the masts of sailing boats visible behind the goal.
beats.light: Floodlights on against an evening sky turning orange, the ball and the two brothers caught in a bright pool of light, the defenders half in shadow.
beats.camera: Dynamic angle from just behind and above the two defenders, the gap between them pointing toward BriBri, slight motion blur on the running legs.
beats.alt: Kaydoudou glisse le ballon entre deux défenseurs madrilènes et le range chez son frère, qui entre dans la surface.

beats.anchor: « Londres ? On va voir la Reine ! »
beats.outfit: Papa Armand: tall, short neat beard, a light blue shirt. Maman Estelle: braids gathered in a bun, big gold earrings, a teal and yellow wax print dress. BriBri (14) in his green sweatshirt, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist. Kaydoudou (12) still in his sand gold Costa Daurada shirt with a navy band, red sock on his RIGHT foot, yellow sock on his LEFT foot.
beats.action: Around a small table, Kaydoudou has shot up from his chair, both arms raised, eyes shining, mouth wide open with excitement. Maman throws her head back, bursting out laughing. Papa, his fork set down on his plate, smiles warmly. BriBri, chin in his hand, looks out toward the sea with a thoughtful half smile. On the table: slices of bread rubbed with tomato, glasses of water, and two winner's medals on ribbons, shining.
beats.location: The rooftop terrace of a narrow, tall stone house in a Catalan hill village, with a view over dark vineyards down to the sea.
beats.light: Night, a sky full of stars, a warm lamp on the table lighting the faces, moonlight on the sea.
beats.camera: Medium shot across the table, slightly from above, the family framed against the starry sky and the sea.
beats.alt: Sur le terrat, sous les étoiles, Kaydoudou bondit de sa chaise pour aller voir la Reine et Maman éclate de rire.
